Event.description: One activity of the Ajuntament's agendas (agenda diària, agenda cultural, agenda d'activitats esportives), the day it starts and ends, where it happens and its category.

address.description: The postal address as the agenda or the facility register publishes it, field by field (Smart Data Models' common PostalAddress); a field the source leaves out is absent.

category.description: An Event's main category first, one of the platform's fifteen event codes (music, theatre-dance, film, exhibition-museum, festival-fair, sport, outdoor-nature, education-talk, children-family, hobby-workshop, food-market, history-heritage, faith-tradition, health-wellness, community-civic), then the Smart Data Models category it falls under where one fits, read from the first words of the Catalan name and absent when no rule matches. A PointOfInterest's family in the city's facility register first (culture-leisure, sports, education, social-services, public-administration, markets-shopping, information-centres, religious-services, environment, animals-plants, cemeteries, media, utility-companies, restaurants), then the register's own kind in Catalan (Biblioteques, Poliesportius).

contactPoint.description: The public telephone line the agenda or the facility register lists.

endDate.description: The last day of the event, local midnight in Europe/Madrid; absent when the agenda gives none.
